'''Aldrin Caldevwin''' is a Captain in the [[Cairhienin]] army. His banner bears a single white star.

==Appearance==
He has shaven and dusted the front of his hair in the fashion of a Cairhienin soldier. His hair is long and dark at the back.

==Activities==
He is in charge of clearing free the male [[Choedan Kal]].

He meets [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[The Nine Rings (inn)]] and interrogates him.{{ref/book|2|21}}

He assigns [[Elricain Tavolin]] to be Rand's bodyguard while Rand is in Cairhien. He is surprised when Rand tells him [[Selene]] left The Nine Rings during the night even though he had soldiers watching it.

He is in the guard house one day when Rand asks about [[Ingtar]] and Selene but ducks out of sight and the clerk pretends that he is not present.{{ref/book|2|30}}
